title: Telli (YC F24) is hiring engineers and designers [Berlin, on-site]
summary: Telli, a Y Combinator Winter 2024 batch startup based in Berlin, is actively recruiting engineers and designers for on-site positions. The company is using Hacker News as a hiring channel to attract talent.
problem_solved: Helps Telli acquire engineering and design talent for their Berlin-based startup
why_valuable: Provides an opportunity to join an early-stage YC-backed company with potential for growth and impact
